Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities plunged nearly 1% before recovering due to escalating US-Iran tensions, soaring crude prices, and global bond stress. The Sensex closed 374 points lower and the Nifty fell 141 points, with analysts warning of continued bearishness below 24,000.

Markets.title: JM Financial Asset Management garners Rs 700 crore from maiden pre-IPO fund
Markets.summary: JM Financial Asset Management raised Rs 700 crore for the first close of its new pre-IPO fund. The fund will make sector-agnostic investments in companies planning to go public within 18 months.

Markets.title: Banks rush to swap higher-risk credit assets for Bank of England cash
Markets.summary: British banks are increasingly using higher-risk assets as collateral to obtain cash from the Bank of England, reaching levels not seen since March 2020. Unlike the European Central Bank, the Bank of England accepts these loan-backed securities while maintaining strict risk management to protect its interests.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Ageis Vopak Terminals among 2 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities remained volatile due to global bond-market stress and West Asia tensions, putting pressure on mid-caps. Despite this, analysts recommend SKF India and Aegis Vopak Terminals for potential upside based on technical breakouts, strong volumes, and improving momentum.

Markets.title: Dell shares jump 11% after strong AI server demand boosts annual forecast
Markets.summary: Dell shares surged 11% on Wednesday after reporting a 58% increase in second-quarter revenue to reach $47 billion. The company credited this growth to booming demand for AI servers and subsequently upgraded its annual revenue and profit forecasts.

Markets.title: Rising global bond yields, FCNR-B inflows and SEBI's CAS to shape market dynamics: HDFC Securities CEO Dhiraj Relli
Markets.summary: Rising global bond yields and surging oil prices are increasing inflation and threatening corporate profits in India. Meanwhile, SEBI's new auction initiative and the RBI's deposit guidelines are helping address market integrity and foreign exchange pressures.

Geo-Political.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian media reported that an alleged US strike killed four people, including two children, at a home during a wedding. In response to the strike, which Iran condemned as a war crime while the US denied targeting civilians, Iran launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

Geo-Political.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
Geo-Political.summary: The EU and NATO have promised to increase pressure on Russia following a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport. Berlin blamed Moscow for the incident, citing it as evidence of a new escalation and increasingly reckless behavior by Russia.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a veiled threat to the United Kingdom as part of an ongoing campaign against Western nations. This tactic is intended to keep Britain uncertain and anxious regarding Moscow's true intentions.

Geo-Political.title: US sailors arrive in Thailand's Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
Geo-Political.summary: The US aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln and its sailors arrived in Pattaya, Thailand, following a record 250 days at sea. Pattaya is a coastal city widely known for its nightlife and sex tourism industries.

Geo-Political.title: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
Geo-Political.summary: Dawn Light was charged with juror intimidation for taking prohibited photographs of jurors outside the Plymouth courthouse. The incident occurred during the trial of Lindsay Clancy.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged international airlines to stop flying over Russia as Ukraine increases its drone attacks. In response, Russia stated that it will intensify its own military strikes against Ukraine.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: Centre defends GDP estimates, says revisions reflect updated data, methodology
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government defended its recent GDP estimates, denying allegations that it manipulated the June quarter growth figures. Officials explained that the revisions were based on updated data and improved methodologies rather than artificial inflation.

Data & Insights.title: BJP Vs Congress: ‘Not comparing apples with apples?’ Piyush Goyal hits back at Congress criticism of GDP numbers
Data & Insights.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal defended India's latest GDP growth numbers against Congress criticism. The economy grew faster than expected despite global concerns over the US-Iran war.

Data & Insights.title: How a stalled mall in Srinagar fetched a massive amount in auction - more than double govt expectation
Data & Insights.summary: An overnight auction for land in front of and behind Sangarmaal in Srinagar concluded early on 26 August with a winning full-lease bid of ₹421.75 crore. This final amount was more than double the government's initial expectation.

Data & Insights.title: '7.8% growth but still import-dependent': Sridhar Vembu explains Modi’s Swadeshi push
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted India's 7.8% real GDP growth in Q1 FY27 while urging citizens to boost local consumption and avoid non-essential spending to conserve foreign exchange. Meanwhile, the RBI revised its FY27 GDP growth forecast downward to 6.7%, amid ongoing concerns over the country's import dependency.

Data & Insights.title: Why a sovereign rating is not the last word on a nation’s creditworthiness
Data & Insights.summary: Sovereign credit ratings measure a country's ability to service its debt obligations across multiple dimensions. Rather than treating these ratings as symbols of national prestige, stakeholders should analyze their specific components.

Data & Insights.title: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay will be in UK from September 10 to 16 - What's on the agenda?
Data & Insights.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay will visit the United Kingdom from September 10 to 16 to engage with global manufacturing hubs. Additionally, a state delegation led by Minister Keerthana will travel to Taiwan on September 4 to attend the Semicon conference.

India.title: "Sure Sign Of Intellectual Dishonesty": SBI Research On Doubts Being Raised On GDP Growth Data
India.summary: State Bank of India Research stated that questioning India's GDP growth data is a sign of intellectual dishonesty. Soumya Kanti Ghosh, the chief economic adviser for SBI, told NDTV that an unnecessary controversy arose due to incorrect data interpretation.

India.title: Flood Warning Systems Failed In Nepal. Can Satellites Strengthen Them?
India.summary: Nepal's flood warning systems recently failed after a glacier collapsed. The geospatial community is now discussing whether satellite observations can improve these early-warning systems.

India.title: BJP Making All Appointments: Akhilesh Yadav's Jibe On Temple Trust Overhaul
India.summary: Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra has been appointed as the first Chief Executive Officer of the temple trust to manage its operations and finances. This appointment drew criticism from Akhilesh Yadav, who accused the BJP of controlling all such positions.

India.title: GATE 2027 Registration Begins Today; Robotics And Automation Added
India.summary: Registration for GATE 2027 has opened at IIT Madras, with the deadline set for September 27. The exam has also been updated to include a new paper on Robotics and Automation.

India.title: "They Should Compare Apples With Apples": Minister Piyush Goyal On GDP Data Critics
India.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal defended India's 7.8 percent GDP growth rate by stating that ministers do not manufacture the data. He advised critics to properly compare economic data rather than questioning its validity.

General.title: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as UK borrowing costs rise
General.summary: During his first Prime Minister's Questions, Burnham was pressed on the economy as UK borrowing costs increased. In response, he highlighted that he had already cut taxes, including VAT on energy bills and business rates for hospitality.

General.title: PMQs shows the challenge Burnham has in delivering new style of politics
General.summary: Prime Minister's Questions revealed that Andy Burnham struggles to deliver a new style of politics. His exchanges with Kemi Badenoch quickly devolved into familiar political barbs.

General.title: 'Nothing but mud and silt' - the village swept away by deadly floods in Nepal
General.summary: Deadly floods in Nepal swept away a village, leaving behind only mud and silt. Rescue efforts are ongoing as a local resident waits for his wife's body to be retrieved.

General.title: Lucy Letby 'boyfriend' doctor named as court order lifted
General.summary: During the trial of serial killer Lucy Letby, Alder Hey hospital consultant Dr Mark Deakin was described as her boyfriend. A court order has now been lifted to publicly name him.

General.title: Watch: What we know about reported strike on Iran wedding celebrations
General.summary: BBC Verify is examining footage that shows the aftermath of a strike on a building in southern Iran. The incident reportedly targeted wedding celebrations.
